raw_response:
This plot is small and rented, so I will keep costs low and manage it mostly with our household labor. For tubers here in Mwanza, I usually rely on local planting material and some manure if I can get it, because chemical fertilizer is expensive and not common for this kind of crop. I do not expect to irrigate, and I will only hire a little help if we need extra hands for clearing or weeding.
